description: List all credit cards with issuer (co-brand/marketing label), issuing_bank (actual bank that issues the card — use for application rule logic), annual fee, renewal month, owner, last 4 digits, and benefit count. Note: issuer and issuing_bank can differ for co-branded cards (e.g., Hilton Aspire has issuer=Hilton, issuing_bank=Amex). Use last_four to match cards against external sources (statements, Gmail, Plaid).
name: list_cards
